newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trading in Chevalier Dev suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading in Chevalier Dev suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of property and civil engineering firm Chevalier Development International Ltd was suspended on Thursday afternoon at the company's request pending an announcement, the stock exchange said.
The company shares were up HK$0.49 or 36.3 percent to HK$1.84 at midday. Volume was 2.45 million shares worth HK$4.29 million.
Chevalier Development engages in property investment and development, construction, civil engineering and the supply and installation of building materials and equipment.
